roleHelp.brand_manager: Create & edit campaigns, review clips, reports. No billing.
roleHelp.brand_finance: Billing, invoices, top-ups, refunds. No campaign editing.

banner.pendingBody: You can still draft campaigns. Submitting unlocks once the team verifies your organization details.
banner.pendingKyc: For individual organizations, complete the owner’s KYC first so the team can verify you.
banner.suspendedBody: New campaigns cannot be submitted. Contact the Clipper team for details.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This organization or campaign does not exist, or you are not a member.

picker.title: Choose an organization
picker.description: Your organizations and client orgs linked through an agency.
picker.emptyBody: Create a brand or agency organization to start building campaigns. Invited by a team? Open the invite link they sent you.

newOrg.title: Create organization
newOrg.description: Used for invoices and verification by the Clipper team.
newOrg.name: Brand name
newOrg.typeBadanHelp: PT, CV, or another entity with a company tax ID (NPWP).
newOrg.typePeroranganHelp: Creator or business owner without a legal entity.
newOrg.peroranganBody: Name, ID number and address are not entered here. After creating the organization you are taken to the KYC page in Account.
newOrg.peroranganKycDone: Your KYC is approved. KYC data is used to verify the organization.
newOrg.agencyHelp: Agencies can manage several client orgs once the client approves the link.
newOrg.verifyNote: New organizations start as Pending verification. You can draft, but can only submit campaigns after verification.

campaigns.title: Campaigns & templates
campaigns.description: All campaigns of this organization. Drafts can be edited, running campaigns are monitored from the dashboard.
campaigns.emptyBody: Build your first campaign with the 7-step builder, or start from a template.
campaigns.emptyTemplatesBody: Save a campaign as a template from the menu in the campaign list.

builder.title: Campaign builder
builder.submitted: Campaign submitted. Pay the invoice so it can go live.
builder.readOnlyBody: Only owners and managers of the organization can build campaigns.
builder.rejectedBody: Fix the brief and submit again.

dashboard.title: Campaign dashboard
dashboard.isTemplate: This is a template. Use it to create a new campaign.
dashboard.inReview: The campaign is being reviewed. Pay the invoice in Billing so it can be approved and go live.
dashboard.statsError: Dashboard figures failed to load. Try reloading.
dashboard.ecpmHint: Total brand cost (spent budget + fees) per 1,000 valid views
dashboard.lowBody: The budget may not be used up by the deadline. Try one of these:
dashboard.noClipsBody: Clips appear here once they pass review and tracking starts.

controls.readOnly: Your role can only view this campaign.

statusHint.live: The campaign is live. Pause it if you need to stop temporarily.
statusHint.paused: The campaign is paused: clippers cannot make new claims.
statusHint.scheduled: The campaign goes live automatically at its start time.
statusHint.in_review: The campaign is in review. Cancelling also voids unpaid invoices.
statusHint.draft: The draft has not been submitted.

controls.endBodyRunning: New claims close and existing clips keep being tracked until the view window ends. This cannot be undone.
controls.endBodyCancel: The campaign is cancelled before going live. Unpaid invoices are voided; paid ones are returned through a refund.
controls.noStatusActions: No status actions for this campaign.
controls.extendHint: The new deadline must be after the current one.
controls.deadlineInvalid: Enter the new deadline date & time.
controls.raiseHint: The new rate applies to views after the change; earlier views keep the old rate.
controls.topupHint: A top-up issues an invoice. The pool grows once the invoice is paid.
controls.topupEmpty: Enter a top-up amount for at least one pool.

done.notify_eligible: Eligible clippers who had not heard yet were notified.

invites.title: Invite clippers
invites.description: Private campaigns are only visible to invited clippers. They get a notification.
invites.usernamesHelp: Separate with commas, spaces or new lines. Max 500 per send.
invites.readOnly: Invites can be sent by owners or managers while the campaign is not finished.
invites.noneAdded: No new invites: {count} usernames were already invited or not found.

pin.title: Pin campaign
pin.description: Pinned campaigns appear at the top of the clipper list. {price} per started week.
pin.activeUntil: Pinned until {date} WIB. A new pin continues from that date.
pin.notRunning: Pins are only for scheduled, live or paused campaigns.
pin.readOnly: Pins are bought by owners, managers or finance.
pin.note: VAT not included. The pin starts once the invoice is paid.

reports.csvHint: All campaign submissions: platform, URL, status, valid views and the latest snapshot figures.
reports.linkHint: Share with your manager or client without login. Valid for 90 days and can be revoked anytime.
reports.onceNote: Copy it now. The link is shown only once; only its fingerprint is stored.
reports.readOnly: Report links are created by owners or managers.
reports.revokeBody: Anyone opening this link will see a Link no longer valid page.

review.title: Clip review
review.description: Clips from campaigns with brand review. Clips not reviewed within {hours} hours are approved automatically.
review.readOnly: Your role can only view the queue. Reviews are done by owners or managers.
review.noCampaignsBody: Choose the Brand review mode in the builder’s Schedule & review step to route clips here.
review.approved: {count, plural, one {# clip approved.} other {# clips approved.}}
review.rejected: {count, plural, one {# clip rejected.} other {# clips rejected.}}
review.failed: {count, plural, one {# clip failed} other {# clips failed}}: {error}
review.rejectTitle: Reject {count, plural, one {# clip} other {# clips}}
review.rejectBody: The clipper sees this reason and can appeal once.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Invoices, payment, refunds and leftover campaign budget.
billing.noAccessBody: Ask the organization owner if you need access to invoices.
billing.emptyBody: Invoices are issued when a campaign is submitted, topped up or pinned.
billing.fakturNotYet: The tax invoice is issued by finance after the payment is matched.
billing.qrisHint: Scan with mobile banking or an e-wallet. The amount {total} is prefilled.
billing.reference: Reference number (required in the transfer note)
billing.referenceNote: Transfer exactly {total} and write {number} in the transfer note so the payment can be matched.
billing.bankMissingBody: Contact the Clipper team for payment instructions.
billing.confirmNote: Finance matches payments manually (usually the same business day). The status changes to Paid once matched.
billing.feeExempt: No new fees on {amount} of budget funded by rollover credit (previous campaign leftover).

leftover.title: Leftover campaign budget
leftover.description: Settled campaigns with creator budget left. Roll it over to the next campaign without new fees, or request a refund.
leftover.mfaNote: Rollovers and refunds move money, so they require two-step verification (TOTP).
leftover.note: Figures come from the campaign pool ledger balance. Refunds are reduced by the transfer fee.
leftover.rolloverBody: The leftover moves to the organization credit for the next campaign, without new fees.
leftover.refundBody: The leftover is transferred to the organization account after finance approves it, minus the transfer fee.
leftover.refundDone: Refund requested. Track it in the refund list.

credit.title: Organization credit
credit.description: Rolled-over leftover budget. Use it to pay the next invoices without a transfer.
credit.emptyBody: Credit appears after a campaign’s leftover budget is rolled over.
credit.payNeedsMfa: Enable MFA to pay with credit
credit.mfaNote: Paying with credit moves money, so it requires two-step verification (TOTP).
credit.payBody: Organization credit decreases by {total} and the invoice is paid immediately. This cannot be undone.
credit.applyHelp: At most {max}. The remainder is paid by transfer/QRIS.
credit.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above 0 and at most {max}.
credit.applyBody: Credit of {applied} is reserved for this invoice; the remaining {due} is paid by transfer/QRIS. You can release the credit while the invoice is unpaid.

rewardTypes.title: Reward types
rewardTypes.description: Your organization’s reward units (e.g. Diamonds, vouchers). The rupiah value per unit is the basis for fees & tax.
rewardTypes.readOnly: Reward types are managed by owners or managers.
rewardTypes.emptyBody: Campaigns can still pay in rupiah. Create a reward type for non-cash rewards.
rewardTypes.name: Name
rewardTypes.unitHelp: Shown next to amounts, e.g. Diamonds.
rewardTypes.idrHelp: Basis for fee and tax calculation.

fulfillmentHelp.manual_export: The team exports the recipient list and the brand delivers.
fulfillmentHelp.code_pool: Uploaded voucher codes are handed out automatically, one code per claim.
fulfillmentHelp.webhook: The system calls the brand endpoint (HMAC) for each claim.

rewardTypes.webhookKeep: Leave empty to keep the current URL.
rewardTypes.secretOnce: The HMAC secret is generated on save and shown only once.
rewardTypes.rotateHelp: The old secret stops working immediately.
rewardTypes.recipientHelp: Data clippers fill in when claiming, e.g. game ID. Personal data (PII) is stored in Account, not here.
rewardTypes.formHint: Once a campaign pool uses a reward type, its code, kind, rupiah value, decimals and fulfillment are locked.
rewardTypes.lockedNote: If campaigns already use this reward type, only change the name, label, stock or recipient fields.

invalid.name: Name needs at least 2 characters.
invalid.fields: Each field needs a label and a key (lowercase letters, digits, _).

rewardTypes.secretBody: Use this secret to verify HMAC signatures. It cannot be viewed again after closing this dialog.
rewardTypes.codesHelp: One code per line, or separated by spaces/commas. Max {max} codes per upload.
rewardTypes.codesSubmit: Upload {count, plural, one {# code} other {# codes}}

team.title: Team
team.inviteBody: Pick a role, then share the link yourself via WhatsApp or email. The link is valid for 7 days and works once.
team.inviteCreated: The invite link is ready to share.
team.onceNote: Copy it now. The link is shown only once.
team.ownerOnly: Only the organization owner can invite and manage members.
team.viaAgency: You access this org through an agency. Members are managed by the client org’s owner.
team.manageNote: An organization always keeps at least one Owner. Removed members lose access immediately.
team.removeBody: They lose access to this organization right away. You can invite them again with a new link.
team.revokeBody: This link can no longer be used.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Organization profile, invoicing details and agency links.
settings.name: Brand name
settings.peroranganNote: Name, ID number and address of an individual organization come from the owner’s KYC in Account.
settings.editNote: Changing the legal name, NPWP, or address sends the organization back to verification; new campaigns can't be submitted until it is verified.
settings.rejectedFix: Fix the data with Edit details, then the Clipper team reviews it again.
settings.resubmittedBody: Details updated {date}. The Clipper team will review again.
settings.editHint: The brand name can change freely. Legal name, NPWP, and address must match the business documents.
settings.reverifyWarn: Legal details changed: the organization will be verified again.
settings.savedReverify: Saved. The organization is awaiting re-verification.

agency.title: Agency
agency.agencyBody: Send a link request to a client org. Once the client owner approves, agency members hold the same role in the client org.
agency.clientIdHelp: Ask the client owner to copy the ID from their Settings page.
agency.clientBody: Only approve agencies you know. Access can be revoked anytime and ends immediately.
agency.clientOwnerOnly: Agency requests are approved or revoked by the organization owner.
agency.revokeBody: Agency members immediately lose access to this client org.
agency.revokeClientBody: Agency members immediately lose access to this organization.

done.request: Request sent to the client owner.

campaign.rejected: Campaign {campaign} was rejected. See the reason and fix it.
campaign.settled: Campaign {campaign} settled. Report & leftover budget are ready.

budget.projection_low: {campaign} is projected to use only {projected}% of its budget. See suggestions on the dashboard.

submission.pending_review: New clip waiting for review in {campaign}

org.verified: {org} is verified. You can now submit campaigns.

agency.link_requested: {agency} asked to link {org} as a client

managed.draft_ready: Managed draft {campaign} is ready for approval

field.name: Name must be 2–100 characters.
field.legal_name: Legal name is required for business entities.
field.perorangan_pii: Individual organizations do not fill in legal name, NPWP or address.
field.rate_not_higher: The new rate must be higher than the old one.
field.rule_id: This rate rule is no longer active. Reload the page.
field.submit_deadline: The new deadline must be after the current one.
field.pools: Enter a top-up amount for at least one pool.
field.fulfillment: This reward type is not a code pool.
field.template: Templates cannot run. Duplicate it into a campaign first.
field.address: Business address is required (used on tax invoices).

code.insufficient_balance: Amount exceeds the campaign’s leftover budget.
code.insufficient_credit: Organization credit is not enough for this invoice.
